g.text: Transfer from relatives: the main strategy
Persian, Dari and Tajik share most
• cross-lingual transfer runs almost entirely through Persian or English as pivots
• a multilingual model that covers Persian does not cover Dari unless Dari data was included
• tokenizers are calibrated for high-resource languages and over-segment related varieties
• systematic intra-family transfer studies are still lacking
Relatedness is an asset, but nobody has measured it systematically yet.
